description: Black-and-white photo composite meme showing Donald Trump at center, unsmiling, surrounded by more than a dozen suited arms pointing handguns at his head from all sides. Each gun is labeled with the name of a media outlet, political group, or institution, framing Trump as besieged by hostile establishment forces.
text: BOSTON GLOBE. GOP ELITES. CBS. ENTERTAINMENT INDUSTRY. CNN. WASHINGTON POST. ABC. CNBC. CLINTON MACHINE. NEW YORK TIMES. DNC. WHITE HOUSE. GLOBALIST ELITES. MSNBC. SPECIAL INTEREST. POLITICO. UNIVISION. UNITED NATIONS. NBC. WALL STREET.

description: Screenshot of a tweet from the verified account Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump), posted Oct 6, 2020, announcing he has fully authorized total declassification of all documents pertaining to the Russia investigation, which he calls the Russia Hoax, and the Hillary Clinton email matter, with no redactions. It quotes a tweet by Paul Sperry (@paulsperry_) claiming declassification will show the FBI and CIA knew the collusion allegations were a political dirty trick and were in on it.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. I have fully authorized the total Declassification of any & all documents pertaining to the single greatest political CRIME in American History, the Russia Hoax. Likewise, the Hillary Clinton Email Scandal. No redactions!. Paul Sperry @paulsperry_ - 23h. When all the documents are finally declassified, and all the redactions removed from reports, the nation will see that the FBI and CIA not only knew the Russia "collusion" allegations against Trump were a political dirty trick, but that they were in on the trick. 5:41 PM - Oct 6, 2020 - Twitter for iPhone. 2.9K Retweets. 526 Quote Tweets. 6.6K Likes.
flags: Tweet asserts unverified claims (Russia investigation as a crime/hoax; FBI/CIA complicity) reported here as claims, not facts

description: Long-exposure night webcam photograph from SkunkBayWeather.com, timestamped Jun 10, 2018, 03:56:14 AM, looking over Puget Sound near Hansville, Washington. A bright vertical streak of light rises from the horizon into low clouds at upper left. The image circulated as claimed evidence of a missile launch near Whidbey Island; analysts and the U.S. military found no launch, and a helicopter light trail in the long exposure was offered as a likely explanation.
text: SkunkBayWeather.com  Jun 10, 2018  03:56:14 AM. Temp:  47.7°F, Wind: SE  at    4 mph, Gust:  8.0 mph, Pressure:  30.0 in, Rain: 0.20 in
flags: Missile-launch interpretation is an unverified claim; the streak was never officially identified and a helicopter long-exposure trail is the commonly cited explanation

description: Extreme zoom-in crop of the June 10, 2018 Skunk Bay Weather webcam image over Puget Sound, showing the bright orange-white vertical streak of light with a small faint dark shape at its tip. Circulated as claimed close-up evidence that the streak was a missile in flight near Whidbey Island. The heavy enlargement is grainy and the object, if any, cannot be identified from the image.
flags: Missile identification is an unverified claim; the enlarged object cannot be identified and the streak is commonly attributed to a helicopter light trail in a long exposure
